The recap must capture every objection distinctly, must not promise a specific discount or an employment outcome to resolve them, and should propose staying in active contact ('contacted') rather than 'conversation_completed' framed as a close-ready state. CONVERTED TO v2 (P1.10d-5). The v1 fixture also asserted the gate `fos.post_call_synthesis.no-prohibited-guarantee`, which this definition NO LONGER DECLARES — the keyword gate was replaced by the stage-7b semantic classifier in #110, so asserting it is now a distinct grader failure (design section 5 rule 4). Stage-7b coverage is asserted via `compliance_review_blocked` instead. v1's `output_schema_constraints` were prose; the mechanizable subset is now `output_assertions`, and the rest stays here, asserted by nothing: the three objections must be price, time-commitment and outcome-skepticism SPECIFICALLY (there is deliberately no keyword operator — only the COUNT is mechanized), followUpBrief/nextAction must never promise a discount, guaranteed placement or interview outcome (the stage-7b classifier is what covers that, asserted via compliance_review_blocked), and openQuestions[] should include something that would clarify whether the time-commitment concern is resolvable.
